title: Aquaculture locality directory
description: Find site identifiers by name or number before retrieving locality data. The current directory includes sites for multiple licensed species.

variables.name: localityNo
variables.description: Site identifier needed by data tools.

variables.name: municipality
variables.description: Municipality name and number are returned by the current directory.

coverage.temporal: Current directory; a separate endpoint lists names of sites that have held salmonoid licenses.

access.authentication: BarentsWatch API client credentials; OAuth2 scope api.
access.method: Provider REST API; only tools listed in download_tools are implemented here.

limitations: Search matches site names or IDs, not municipality names.
Directory membership is not evidence that a site was active or reported in a historical year.
The separate historical salmonoid-license name endpoint is catalogued but not wrapped.

title: Weekly sea-lice counts and reporting flags
description: Site reports of adult female, mobile and stationary salmon lice. Use reporting flags to distinguish absent reports from observed zeroes.

variables.name: avgAdultFemaleLice
variables.description: Provider weekly mean of adult females.

variables.name: avgMobileLice
variables.description: Provider weekly mean of mobile stages.

variables.name: avgStationaryLice
variables.description: Provider weekly mean of stationary stages.

variables.name: hasReportedLice
variables.description: False means accompanying zeroes must not be treated as observed zero lice.

coverage.temporal: Dataset-specific; Fish Health includes historical data from 2012, with field-specific changes.

access.authentication: BarentsWatch API client credentials; OAuth2 scope api.
access.method: Provider REST API; only tools listed in download_tools are implemented here.

limitations: Use dataset=lice_stages for stage counts and reporting flags.
The older adult-female-only tool lacks the richer reporting flag.
National annual averages require an explicit weighting rule and are not calculated by this MCP.
Reports can contain source errors.

title: Weekly water temperature at aquaculture sites
description: Reported temperature at or near a fish farm with a reporting-status flag.

variables.name: hasReported
variables.description: Whether a measurement was reported for the week.

coverage.temporal: Dataset-specific; Fish Health includes historical data from 2012, with field-specific changes.

access.authentication: BarentsWatch API client credentials; OAuth2 scope api.
access.method: Provider REST API; only tools listed in download_tools are implemented here.

limitations: Use dataset=sea_temperature.
Unreported and future weeks can have null temperatures; no interpolation is performed.

title: Sea-lice treatments
description: Reported medicinal, non-medicinal, mechanical and combination interventions, with historical cleaner-fish records where available.

variables.name: medicinalTreatments
variables.description: Treatment substance and method where supplied.

coverage.temporal: Dataset-specific; Fish Health includes historical data from 2012, with field-specific changes.

access.authentication: BarentsWatch API client credentials; OAuth2 scope api.
access.method: Provider REST API; only tools listed in download_tools are implemented here.

limitations: Use dataset=treatments. Treatment lists remain nested; the MCP does not estimate doses or treatment counts.
Cleaner-fish reporting is not included after week 16 of 2018.
Fields can vary by provider record version.

title: Aquaculture disease cases
description: Disease case records and their suspicion, diagnosis, emptying and closure dates, including ISA and pancreas disease where recorded.

coverage.temporal: Dataset-specific; Fish Health includes historical data from 2012, with field-specific changes.

access.authentication: BarentsWatch API client credentials; OAuth2 scope api.
access.method: Provider REST API; only tools listed in download_tools are implemented here.

limitations: Use dataset=diseases.
A case returned for one year may have started in an earlier year; this is not a count of new cases.
The connector uses version 3; legacy and all-years endpoints are only catalogued.

title: Farmed-fish escape incidents
description: Reported escape events returned in weekly groups for a selected locality and year.

variables.name: escapes
variables.description: Provider escape-event details, retained as supplied.

coverage.temporal: Dataset-specific; Fish Health includes historical data from 2012, with field-specific changes.

access.authentication: BarentsWatch API client credentials; OAuth2 scope api.
access.method: Provider REST API; only tools listed in download_tools are implemented here.

limitations: Use dataset=escapes.
Empty event lists are returned without inventing zero-event weeks. Reported escapes do not directly measure effects on wild stocks.

title: Permitted aquaculture site capacity
description: Weekly permitted capacity of an aquaculture site under its administrative authorization.

variables.name: capacity
variables.description: Permitted site capacity for the reporting week.

coverage.temporal: Dataset-specific; Fish Health includes historical data from 2012, with field-specific changes.

access.authentication: BarentsWatch API client credentials; OAuth2 scope api.
access.method: Provider REST API; only tools listed in download_tools are implemented here.

limitations: Use dataset=capacity.
The capacity endpoint omits its unit. Inspect aquaCultureRegister.unit in a site snapshot before using the value.
Do not substitute capacity for annual production, harvests or actual standing biomass.

title: Aquaculture site and health snapshot
description: Nested weekly site record combining coordinates, license information, authorized species, capacity units, disease, lice, temperature and treatment fields.

variables.name: aquaCultureRegister
variables.description: Licenses, capacity unit, organizations and authorized species.

variables.name: liceReport
variables.description: Counts, temperature, hasReported and isFallow flags.

variables.name: diseases
variables.description: Disease cases relevant to the snapshot.

coverage.temporal: Dataset-specific; Fish Health includes historical data from 2012, with field-specific changes.

access.authentication: BarentsWatch API client credentials; OAuth2 scope api.
access.method: Provider REST API; only tools listed in download_tools are implemented here.

limitations: Licensed species do not prove that those species were actually present.
This snapshot is exported as nested JSON; no cross-source join is done.
Historical interpretation requires attention to provider reporting changes.

title: Provider summaries of sites above lice thresholds
description: Counts and proportions of sites above the general lice threshold by week, year or current county, calculated by the data provider.

variables.name: averageProportionOfLocalitiesOverLimit
variables.description: Provider annual proportion above the threshold.

coverage.temporal: Dataset-specific; Fish Health includes historical data from 2012, with field-specific changes.

access.authentication: BarentsWatch API client credentials; OAuth2 scope api.
access.method: Provider REST API; only tools listed in download_tools are implemented here.

limitations: Catalogue only: the current MCP does not download these summaries.
These are threshold exceedance measures, not national mean lice per fish.
Regional grouping uses current counties. Special regulatory exemptions may not be represented.

title: National and multi-site weekly health overview
description: Provider weekly overview endpoints summarize or list sites with health and lice-report information.

variables.name: site health summary
variables.description: Weekly overview fields; inspect the operation response schema.

coverage.temporal: Dataset-specific; Fish Health includes historical data from 2012, with field-specific changes.

access.authentication: BarentsWatch API client credentials; OAuth2 scope api.
access.method: Provider REST API; only tools listed in download_tools are implemented here.

limitations: Catalogue only: multi-site summary endpoints are not yet wrapped.
A national overview is not a production-weighted national annual lice indicator.

variables.description: Species represented in the aquaculture register.

coverage.temporal: Dataset-specific; Fish Health includes historical data from 2012, with field-specific changes.

access.authentication: BarentsWatch API client credentials; OAuth2 scope api.
access.method: Provider REST API; only tools listed in download_tools are implemented here.

variables.name: health export fields
variables.description: Columns and filters are defined by the provider export endpoint.

coverage.temporal: Dataset-specific; Fish Health includes historical data from 2012, with field-specific changes.

access.authentication: BarentsWatch API client credentials; OAuth2 scope api.
access.method: Provider REST API; only tools listed in download_tools are implemented here.

limitations: Catalogue only: the MCP currently retrieves one site-year at a time rather than invoking this bulk exporter.
Provider asks bulk-download clients to use one thread, without parallel requests.
Cleaner-fish records stop after week 16 of 2018.

variables.name: zone history
